attributes.name: Pirate Hunting
attributes.powers:
Summon and encounter a random ship, or a random monster if you are not on a ship. If the summoned card is not defeated, leave this barrier faceup on the location deck and put the summoned card next to it. Characters at this location encounter the summoned card as their first exploration each turn.

If the summoned card is defeated, banish it; this barrier is also defeated.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barrier Pirate Hunting, change "If the summoned card is undefeated" to "If the summoned card is not defeated". (This card also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: When the ship or monster summoned by Pirate Hunting is evaded, what happens to the barrier?
